d: China is facing fresh international criticism after 14 nations, including the Philippines, the US, the UK and Japan, commemorated the 2016 UN tribunal ruling that rejected Beijing’s sweeping nine-dash line claims in the South China Sea. In a joint statement, the countries called on China to stop what they described as destabilising activities in the region. The Philippines had challenged Beijing at The Hague to secure access to resources in the West Philippine Sea, but China has dismissed the ruling as a “worthless piece of paper” and continued asserting its maritime claims.
